name: poptonium
description: Companion backend for the Poptonium Plex client. Allows serving custom sections, curations and ratings, integrates with Overseerr and facilitates other extra functionalities on top of Plex.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent data: SQLite cache DB and custom sections.

ports.name: WebUI / API Port
ports.description: Container port for the web admin UI and API. Keep the host port at 8085: the app falls back to the Plex host on a hardcoded 8085 when no reverse proxy is in front of it.

variables.name: MDBLIST_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. mdblist.com API key: the source for all ratings (IMDb/RT/TMDB/Metacritic/MDbList) plus the Discover feed. Blank disables ratings and the popular feed; the rest still works.

variables.name: OVERSEERR_URL
variables.description: Optional. Overseerr base URL (e.g. http://overseerr:5055) for request/search proxy.

variables.name: OVERSEERR_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Overseerr API key. Blank disables the Overseerr proxy.

variables.name: OPENSUBTITLES_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. OpenSubtitles app API key (opensubtitles.com, Profile, API Consumers). Required for online subtitle search/download.

variables.name: OPENSUBTITLES_USERNAME
variables.description: Optional. OpenSubtitles account username; its daily download quota (20/day free) is used for downloads.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Optional. Container timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Sets the 'server time' used by the nightly ratings-sync schedule.
